# Security policy

This project is a native port of a retail game. It does not distribute game content, keys, firmware or the game executable. Reports about the game itself, the RPCS3 emulator or the console firmware do not belong here.

## What to report privately

- A vulnerability in the Launcher, in the build scripts or in the runtime code of this repository.
- A leak of personal data, keys or game files through the repository or the build process.

## How to report

Send a private message to the maintainer on the ps3recomp Discord, user `@samukambr`, or open a private security advisory on GitHub (Security tab, Report a vulnerability). Do not open a public issue for a security problem.

## What not to send

EBOOT, `.psarc`, decryption keys, firmware or any file extracted from the game. If a report requires one of those to reproduce, describe the file and its origin instead of attaching it.
